name: Archery
overview: Scripture reveals archery as both a practical skill and a symbol of warfare among various peoples, including Ishmael who became an archer in the wilderness (Genesis 21:20), and Esau who was instructed to take his weapons and bow for hunting (Genesis 27:3). Archers are depicted as instruments of conflict, causing grief and hostility (Genesis 49:23), while strategically positioned defenders wield bows alongside swords and spears to protect their communities (Nehemiah 4:13). The presence of archers is also associated with the challenges faced by God's people, yet those delivered from their attacks praise the Lord’s righteous acts (Judges 5:11).
